description: Auto-mount ashpipe portals when Claude Code starts in an ashpipe workspace

hooks.command: if command -v ashpipe >/dev/null 2>&1; then dir="$PWD"; while [ "$dir" != "/" ]; do if [ -f "$dir/.ashpipe/config.yaml" ]; then (cd "$dir" && if ashpipe mount --help 2>&1 | grep -q -- "--best-effort"; then ashpipe mount --timeout 5s --best-effort; else ashpipe mount --timeout 5s; fi >/dev/null 2>&1) || true; break; fi; dir="${dir%/*}"; [ -n "$dir" ] || dir="/"; done; fi
